description: The bar chart illustrates the CoLeG-R percentage for two models, LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, under different SFT conditions. The horizontal axis represents the model categories, labeled as LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis is labeled "CoLeG-R (%)", with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 in intervals of 10. Each model category is represented by a group of four bars, colored blue, yellow, purple, and pink, corresponding to "no SFT", "+ SFT on D0", "+ SFT on D0, D1", and "+ SFT on D0, D1, D2", respectively. For LLaMA-2-13B, the bars have approximate values of 68%, 67%, 80%, and 84%, while for LLaMA-2-70B, the values are approximately 81%, 74%, 85%, and 84%. The bars within each group are not sorted in a specific order, but are instead arranged according to the SFT conditions as indicated by the legend. The chart does not visually emphasize any particular bar.
